He corked the bottle, walked to the point, and threw it as far as his arm allowed.", "w02": "凌晨四点，城市像一个尚未醒来的人。路灯还亮着，光却已经显得多余。清扫车沿着空荡的马路缓慢驶过，水迹在柏油上留下一道发亮的痕。早点铺的卷帘门哗啦一声升起来，蒸笼的白气涌出，混进微凉的空气里。出租车停在十字路口，司机把头靠在车窗上打盹。地铁口还锁着，报刊亭的灯泡发出微弱的嗡声。远处高楼的玻璃映着一点天光，是那种介于灰蓝与淡紫之间的颜色。没有人说话，可你能听见整座城市翻了个身，准备再一次开始。", "w03": "- Recursion is when something solves a problem by asking a smaller copy of itself to solve a smaller version of the same problem.\n- Imagine standing in a long line and wanting to know your position: you ask the person in front of you, they ask the person in front of them, until the very first person says \"I'm number one\" — then the answers come back down the line.\n- Every recursion needs a stopping point (like \"I'm number one\"), or it would keep asking forever and never finish."}
